name: skilder
description: One place to maintain the skills, MCP servers and MCP Apps your team's agents use. Set them up once in a Skilder workspace, credentials included, and every connected agent gets each published change on its next task: no copies to sync, nothing to reinstall, and an audit trail of every call.

interface.shortDescription: Skills, MCP and Apps, in sync
interface.longDescription: Skilder is one place to maintain the skills, MCP servers and MCP Apps your team's agents use. Your team builds them once in a Skilder workspace and groups them into plugins. ChatGPT, Codex and any other MCP client the team uses read that same workspace, so a published change reaches every agent on its next task, with no copies to sync and nothing to reinstall. In ChatGPT, you sign in once. For each task, ChatGPT takes on the plugin that fits, follows its skills, calls its tools and opens its MCP Apps in the conversation. The workspace stays in charge. Credentials for the connected tools are kept in the workspace, guardrails check tool calls before they run, admins can switch a tool off, and every call is recorded in Activity, whichever agent made it. Requires a Skilder account: get started at docs.skilder.ai.
defaultPrompt: Get me started with Skilder and show my workspace.
Do this task with the Skilder plugin that fits.
Turn this conversation into a skill for my team.
